title: Large Flux Capacitor
description: The Large Flux Capacitor provides the maximum motive force for your inter-dimensional aluminum automobile.

title: Medium Flux Capacitor
description: The Medium Flux Capacitor is a great budget option if you don't need to travel far in your inter-dimensional aluminum automobile.

title: Small Flux Capacitor
description: The Small Flux Capacitor is the entry-level model, fine for short hops between adjacent dimensions.

title: Dimensional Steering Wheel Cover
description: Hand-stitched leather cover that stays put even when the road folds back on itself.

title: Anti-Gravity Tire Set
description: A set of four titanium-belted tires that keep a heavy vehicle a polite ten centimetres above the ground.

title: Turbo Exhaust Whistle
description: Clip-on exhaust whistle that adds a satisfying rising note as the engine spools up.

title: Temporal Fuel Additive (1L)
description: One litre of additive that lets a tank of fuel run slightly further into next Tuesday.

title: Pocket Hologram Projector
description: Projects a life-size hologram from a device small enough to lose in a coat pocket.

title: Quantum Desk Fan
description: A whisper-quiet desk fan that is simultaneously on and off until you look at it.

title: Noise-Cancelling Headphones
description: Over-ear headphones with thirty hours of battery life and a very convincing silence.

title: Smart Toaster with Opinions
description: A connected toaster that browns evenly and will tell you, unprompted, that you are having too much bread.

title: Solar Phone Charger
description: Foldable solar panel that tops up a phone from flat in an afternoon of decent sunshine.

title: Wireless Mechanical Keyboard
description: Compact tenkeyless keyboard with tactile switches and a battery that lasts for months.

title: Portable Black Hole Speaker
description: A Bluetooth speaker with a surprisingly deep bass response and an event horizon of about four centimetres.

title: Self-Stirring Saucepan
description: Motorised paddle stirs risotto, custard and anything else that needs constant attention.

title: Cast Iron Skillet 12"
description: Pre-seasoned cast iron skillet that goes from hob to oven to campfire and outlives its owner.

title: Anvil-Grade Chef Knife
description: Forged from a single billet of steel, balanced so that it cuts through a pumpkin without complaint.

title: Instant Ice Machine
description: Makes a full tray of clear ice in six minutes, which is faster than most freezers manage in an hour.

title: Ceramic Mug Set (4)
description: Four stoneware mugs with a generous handle and a glaze that survives the dishwasher.

title: Rocket-Powered Blender
description: A blender with a jet-assisted motor that turns a frozen pineapple into a smoothie in four seconds.

title: Two-Person Pop-Up Tent
description: Pitches in under a minute, packs into a flat disc and stays dry in a proper downpour.

title: Insulated Trail Flask
description: Double-walled steel flask that keeps coffee hot for twelve hours and water cold for twenty-four.

title: Rocket Skates
description: Lace-up skates with a small solid-fuel booster in each heel. Helmet strongly recommended.

title: Compass That Points to Snacks
description: A pocket compass whose needle is calibrated to the nearest vending machine.

title: Ultralight Sleeping Bag
description: Down-filled bag rated to minus five degrees that weighs about as much as a bag of sugar.

title: Giant Rubber Band (Industrial)
description: A very large, very stretchy rubber band, suitable for launching things that were not designed to fly.

title: Ergonomic Standing Desk
description: Electric sit-stand desk with four memory presets and a solid bamboo top.

title: Stapler That Never Jams
description: All-metal stapler that drives a hundred sheets through in a single, confident thunk.

title: Dry-Erase Wall Paint (1L)
description: Turns any smooth wall into a whiteboard. Covers roughly four square metres per litre.

title: Vertical Ergonomic Mouse
description: A handshake-grip mouse that takes the strain off the wrist during a long day of spreadsheets.

title: Paper Shredder (Cross-Cut)
description: Cross-cut shredder that eats ten sheets at a time and quietly forgets what it read.

title: Cordless Drill
description: Eighteen-volt drill with two batteries, a brushless motor and a very forgiving clutch.

title: Precision Screwdriver Set
description: Sixty-four bits in a magnetic case, for the screws that manufacturers hide on purpose.

title: Portable Hole (Adhesive, Black)
description: A peel-and-stick hole that opens onto whatever is on the other side of a solid wall.

title: Laser Level
description: Self-levelling cross-line laser that projects a bright green line visible across a large room.

title: Magnetic Wrist Band
description: A strong magnetic band that holds screws, nails and drill bits so that both hands stay free.
